features.text: Workspace builds and unit tests pass headless.
Twin rejects calls without PAT (401), without api-version (400), unknown PR (404); paginates with $top/$skip; returns 429 + Retry-After past its budget.

Stack retarget+rebase: parent PR completed in twin → within one tick child PR targetRefName equals parent's target and its git branch contains no parent commits twice (linear, tip rebased onto new target); chain of 3 resolves across ticks.
Rebase conflict: child left untouched (no force-push), status adoq/stack=failed with message, event logged, other PRs continue.
With twin retargeting=off, bot detects the PATCH did not change targetRefName, posts failed status, does not rebase.
Serial queue: 3 queued PRs complete in FIFO order, each only after its queue build succeeded; target tip history shows that order.
Batching: 4 green PRs complete with ≤ 2 builds total; with 1 red PR in a batch of 4, culprit evicted with failed status, other 3 complete, builds ≤ 5.
Idempotence and restart: killing and restarting adoq mid-batch (SQLite state kept) never double-completes or double-pushes; second tick on unchanged state makes zero mutating API calls.

Reflex CLI: `adoq ls` prints JSON of stacks/queue/batches; `adoq do Enqueue '{"pr":N}'` drives the core; invalid action exits non-zero listing available actions; behaviour tests use only the CLI + twin fixtures.
Safety: PAT never appears in logs/telemetry/db; twin binds 127.0.0.1 only; a guard fails tests making non-loopback connections.
Telemetry: each scenario run appends valid JSON lines tick/retarget/rebase/batch/merge to $DATA_DIR/telemetry.jsonl with documented fields and no personal data.
Bench command's last stdout line is JSON with tick_p50_ms, rss_mb, builds_per_merged_pr; builds_per_merged_pr ≤ 0.3 on the 4-green-PR batch.
Repo holds twins/ado/ README naming the Microsoft Learn pages followed and a LICENSE (MIT).
Open-source release: README for outside developers (copy-lint clean), MIT LICENSE, scripts/check-publishable.sh passes; tests in crates/adoq/tests/publish.rs.
Read wshm's ADO queue and Pro-Sharp code; decide contribute vs build
Real ADO adapter against a personal ADO org
Speculative builds on queue refs via ADO pipelines API
Service hooks (webhook) receiver with polling fallback
Packaging: Docker-free static binary release, config docs, MIT repo, README demo
Policy-aware mode: required-status check setup, bypass detection, reviewer-vote reset warnings
Queue priority, per-PR batch opt-out, and pause/resume
